jobs.description:
SENNA is hiring Junior and Senior Software Engineers
SENNA is an Engineering & IT firm operating in Sweden. We are looking for junior and senior Software Engineers in Stockholm, Gothenburg and Mälardalen.
You will contribute to the development, testing and maintenance of software applications or embedded systems. We welcome developers specialising in backend, frontend, full-stack and embedded development. Your responsibilities will reflect your experience, technical background and interests.
Responsibilities
Develop, test and maintain software applications or embedded systems.
Translate requirements into reliable and maintainable code.
Contribute to technical design, code reviews and documentation.
Troubleshoot issues and improve performance and software quality.
Collaborate with developers, testers, product owners and other stakeholders.

Qualifications
A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
A strong foundation in one or more programming languages, such as Java, C#, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript or C/C++.
Knowledge of Git, testing and structured development practices.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and within a team.
Good written and verbal communication skills in English. Swedish is an advantage.

For junior candidates, we value a solid technical foundation, curiosity and a willingness to learn.
Senior candidates should bring proven experience in software development and the ability to take ownership of technical tasks and design decisions.
Experience with cloud platforms, APIs, CI/CD, embedded systems and AI applications is particularly relevant.

SENNA is hiring Junior and Senior Project Managers
SENNA is an Engineering & IT firm operating in Sweden. We are looking for junior and senior Project Managers in Stockholm, Gothenburg and Mälardalen.
You will bring structure, engage stakeholders and move technical projects forward within engineering, product development, industrial operations or IT. Your responsibilities and the complexity of the projects will reflect your background and experience.
Responsibilities
Define project scope, objectives, deliverables and plans.
Coordinate teams, suppliers and stakeholders.
Manage schedules, budgets, resources and dependencies.
Identify risks, resolve issues and manage changes.
Communicate progress and support decisions through clear reporting.
Follow up on delivery, quality and project outcomes.

Qualifications
A relevant degree in Engineering, IT, Project Management or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Knowledge of project planning, stakeholder management and risk management.
The ability to coordinate people across different functions.
Strong organisational and problem-solving skills, with a structured approach.
Good written and verbal communication skills in English. Swedish is an advantage.

For junior candidates, we value a solid foundation in project coordination, curiosity and a willingness to learn.
Senior candidates should bring proven experience managing technical projects and the ability to take ownership of scope, budget and delivery.
An engineering or IT background, experience with agile, traditional or hybrid project methods, and certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2 or IPMA are particularly relevant.

jobs.description:
IES Österåker är en växande F-9skola med höga ambitioner och en tydlig vision om att varje elev ska ges möjlighet att utvecklas och nå sin fulla potential.

Vi söker nu en engagerad, trygg och initiativrik pedagogisk resurs som vill vara med och skapa bästa möjliga förutsättningar för våra elever att lyckas såväl akademiskt som socialt.Om tjänsten

Som pedagogisk resurs har du en viktig och varierad roll i skolans verksamhet. Du arbetar nära elever som behöver extra stöd och vägledning för att få skoldagen att fungera så bra som möjligt.

Uppdraget handlar om mer än att finnas till hands. Du hjälper elever att utveckla självständighet, studieteknik, struktur och strategier för att hantera olika situationer i skolan. Du är en trygg vuxen som bygger relationer, skapar förtroende och motiverar elever att ta ansvar för sitt eget lärande och sin utveckling.

Du samarbetar nära undervisande lärare, mentorer, specialpedagog och elevhälsoteam för att identifiera behov, hitta fungerande lösningar och följa upp elevernas utveckling.

Arbetsuppgifterna kan bland annat innebära att:

- Ge individuellt stöd till elever under lektioner och andra delar av skoldagen.
- Hjälpa elever att organisera, planera och genomföra skolarbetet.
- Stärka elevernas studieteknik, motivation och förmåga att arbeta självständigt.
- Stötta elever i sociala situationer och bidra till goda relationer och en trygg skolmiljö.
- Hjälpa elever att hantera utmaningar, motgångar och övergångar mellan olika aktiviteter.
- Arbeta förebyggande för att skapa struktur, studiero och en positiv lärmiljö.
- Samarbeta med lärare och elevhälsoteam kring anpassningar och stödinsatser.
- Vara en viktig vuxen som ser, uppmuntrar och utmanar varje elev utifrån deras individuella förutsättningar.Vi söker dig som:

- Har erfarenhet av att arbeta med barn och ungdomar, gärna inom skola eller annan pedagogisk verksamhet.
- Är trygg, lyhörd och har lätt för att skapa goda relationer med elever.
- Har ett genuint intresse för elevers lärande, utveckling och välmående.
- Är tydlig, strukturerad och har förmåga att skapa förutsägbarhet och trygghet.
- Kan möta elever med olika behov och anpassa ditt bemötande efter situationen.
- Har god förmåga att motivera, vägleda och uppmuntra elever att utveckla sin självständighet.
- Är lösningsorienterad, initiativrik och har förmåga att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra.
- Är en god kommunikatör och trivs med ett nära samarbete med kollegor och vårdnadshavare.
- Behärskar svenska och engelska väl.

Det är meriterande om du har utbildning inom pedagogik, beteendevetenskap, socialt arbete eller specialpedagogik.Vi erbjuder

- En viktig och meningsfull roll där du gör verklig skillnad för eleverna.
- Ett nära samarbete med engagerade lärare och elevhälsoteam.
- En strukturerad verksamhet med tydliga rutiner och ett närvarande ledarskap.
- Möjlighet att vara med och utveckla skolans arbete med pedagogiskt stöd.
- En internationell arbetsmiljö med fokus på lärande, respekt och trygghet.

Vi söker dig som tror på varje elevs förmåga att utvecklas och som vill vara med och göra skillnad, varje dag.Anställningsvillkor

Tjänstens omfattning är 100 procent.

Sex månaders provanställning tillämpas.

Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag.

Utdrag ur belastningsregistret ska uppvisas före anställning.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

As Business Area Mining continues its exciting growth journey towards 100 billion SEK in 2030, M&A plays an important part in shaping what comes next. We’re looking for an accomplished M&A professional to help shape this journey through strategic analysis, disciplined deal execution and close collaboration with senior leaders.  
Joining an experienced team with backgrounds in corporate strategy, M&A and top-tier consulting, you gain exceptional insight into our business and work closely with ambitious leaders across the organization. We offer an open, agile and action-oriented environment where we set high standards and achieve our goals together.  
About the job
As M&A Manager, you identify, analyze and evaluate acquisition opportunities aligned with our strategic direction. From sourcing to due diligence and post-closing performance management, you ensure success and alignment with our strategic direction. Your expertise in financial modeling, deal structuring, and valuation is invaluable in discussions and transactions.  
You report to the Vice President Strategy & Business Development for Mining.  
Job responsibilities 
Identify, assess and evaluate potential acquisition targets.  
Lead transactions and key workstreams, with emphasis on financial modeling, valuation and deal-structuring activities 
Lead and support due diligence process securing momentum and stakeholder management 
Prepare decision-making materials for the CEO and Board of Sandvik. 
Collaborate with the management team, business units, external advisors and other key stakeholders.  
Identify key value drivers and risks while contributing to the continued development of our M&A practices.  

Location
The preferred location is our headquarters at the World Trade Center in Stockholm. International travel is part of your job.  
Your profile
You bring extensive M&A experience, strong business acumen and a proven record of successfully executing projects across the transaction lifecycle.  
Your background includes 
A comprehensive M&A experience from investment banking, corporate M&A, private equity or a related field, with proven end-to-end involvement through signing and closing 
Strong capabilities in financial analysis, modeling, valuation and deal structuring.  
Excellent stakeholder management skills in dynamic and complex environments. 
Excellent written and spoken English.  
We see it as an advantage if you have knowledge of the industrial, software or mining sectors.  

Strategic and action-oriented, you combine sound judgement with a flexible, structured and investigative approach. You build trust through clear communication, remain composed under pressure and bring diverse perspectives into your recommendations. Collaboration comes naturally, and you move complex matters forward with confidence and flexibility.  
Our culture 
At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. We invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences.

For further information about this position, please contact James Crilley, Executive Talent Acquisition Expert, james.crilley@sandvik.com

Business area Mining is a global leading supplier of equipment and tools, parts, service, digital solutions and sustainability-driving technologies for the mining and construction industries. Applications include rock drilling, rock cutting, loading and hauling, tunneling and quarrying. In 2025, sales were approximately SEK 63 billion with about 18,400 employees.

Adven is a dynamic energy group, driving the energy transition by developing sustainable and competitive solutions in partnership with customers, municipalities, and suppliers. Together with our 600 employees, we provide industries with steam, heating, cooling and infrastructure services that improve resource efficiency, as well as district heating for households and businesses and geoenergy solutions for large commercial properties.
We have a long and solid track record with more than 50 years of experience within the field. Today we operate over 350 sites in Europe with a total energy volume of 5.1 TWh. Our annual turnover is €424 million, and our total balance sheet €1480 million.
We are now looking for a Senior Concept Manager or Concept Manager to join our Energy Production Solutions team
As a Senior Concept Manager or Concept Manager, your primary responsibility will be to develop viable energy production solutions, transforming early-stage concepts into project-ready designs that are:

Aligned with customer needs

Sustainable

Executable within defined schedules, scopes, and operational performance

In this role, you will identify solution opportunities for customers and shape the initial vision of each project. You will collaborate with industrial clients to create sustainable, value-driven technical solutions. This involves defining optimized energy production concepts including energy balances and preparing CAPEX and OPEX calculations. You will also initiate procurement of key technologies and pre-engineering works while coordinating with our project management and O&M teams during the project development and pre-engineering phase. Close collaboration with Energy as a Service sales function and other internal stakeholders is essential part of your daily work.
Location
The position is based in Stockholm, Sweden. This is a Group-level role that requires some travel between Adven’s operating countries across Northern Europe.
We work flexibly in a hybrid model, combining office and remote work, with approximately three days per week in the office and two days working remotely. During the onboarding period, we expect a high level of office presence to support learning and integration into the team.
To succeed in this role we expect you to have

Relevant university level education

A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience, with hands-on expertise in industrial scale energy production, preferably from planning to project execution

Strong knowledge of relevant technologies like combustion boiler plants and/or electric boilers and energy efficiency

Excellent problem-solving skills and a hands-on approach

Proactive, results-oriented mindset with strong teamwork capabilities

Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

Excellent communication and writing skills in both Swedish and English

Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)

Willingness to travel within Sweden and other locations where Adven operates.

Experience from of Energy as a service model, solution selling or energy production projects is an asset.

At Adven
You will have the opportunity to work with highly skilled colleagues who are passionate about building sustainable energy solutions and supporting the industrial green transition.
Together we deliver projects that create real environmental and business value for our customers. When we grow, you grow and develop with us.
We offer you
An international and fast-growing company where you will work on technically challenging and strategically important projects.
The opportunity to develop technically and commercially viable concepts for industrial customers and turn early-stage ideas into executable projects.
A supportive and collaborative work environment, clear targets, modern working tools and a comprehensive package of employee benefits.
To apply
Please submit your application and CV in English by January 3rd, 2027. We review applications during the application period and proceed with the process as soon as a suitable candidate is found.
Please note that we do not accept applications via email. We also do not accept unsolicited approaches or proposals from recruitment agencies or service providers.

We don’t just build technology. We build hope for everyone dealing with Cancer.
Elekta is shaping the standard of care, together with healthcare providers, by developing precision radiation medicine that brings advanced radiotherapy into routine clinical practice. Our solutions support consistent, efficient and personalized care, addressing evolving patient needs. Through adaptive radiotherapy, precision treatment delivery and integrated workflows, Elekta supports care teams across a range of clinical settings. Each year more than 2 million patients are treated using Elekta solutions across over 130 countries. Elekta is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, with over 4,000 employees and offices in more than 40 countries. The company is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. For more information, visit elekta.com.
What You’ll Do At Elekta
As a Field Service Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the performance, reliability, and safety of Elekta’s advanced radiotherapy solutions across the Nordic region, with a primary focus on MR-Linac systems. Reporting to the Regional Service Manager, you will work independently to install, maintain, troubleshoot, and support highly sophisticated medical technology that directly contributes to patient care.
This is a home-based position requiring frequent travel throughout the Nordic region and occasional travel outside the region. Due to the location of our clients, we prefer candidates who are based in southern Sweden. You will work closely with customers, colleagues, and technical support teams to deliver exceptional service and maintain strong long-term customer relationships. 

Responsibilities 
Install, commission, upgrade, and maintain Elekta systems, with a focus on MR-Linac solutions. 
Perform planned preventive maintenance and emergency corrective maintenance activities at customer sites. 
Diagnose and repair complex electronic, mechanical, networking, and software-related issues down to board and component level. 
Support customers through on-site visits, courtesy calls, and remote technical assistance. 
Manage service activities independently while ensuring timely escalation of complex technical issues when required. 
Complete service documentation, reports, and quality records accurately and on time. 
Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with Elekta quality standards, safety procedures, and regulatory requirements. 
Build strong relationships with customers through professional, responsive, and customer-focused support. 
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance service quality and customer satisfaction. 
Promote service upgrades, system enhancements, and additional solutions where appropriate. 
Maintain technical expertise across Elekta's service portfolio through ongoing training and development. 
Share knowledge and provide guidance or training to colleagues when required. 
Support occasional weekend service activities, typically limited to business-critical customer needs.

What You’ll Bring 
Degree, HNC, technical diploma, or equivalent qualification in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Medical Engineering, or a related discipline. 
Demonstrated experience in field service, technical support, installation, or maintenance engineering environment. 
Strong troubleshooting and fault-finding capabilities across complex electro-mechanical systems. 
Experience working with electronics, networking, PCs, servers, and Windows-based environments. 
Knowledge of high/low voltage systems, vacuum systems, RF technology, diagnostic equipment, or other advanced engineering disciplines is highly desirable. 
Ability to analyze problems systematically and identify effective solutions under pressure. 
Strong customer service mindset with the ability to build credibility and trust with healthcare professionals. 
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Knowledge of a Nordic language is advantageous. 
Ability to work independently, prioritize workloads, and manage multiple service activities simultaneously. 
Willingness and ability to travel approximately 40% of the time throughout the Nordic region and occasionally internationally. 
Valid driving license. 
A collaborative, proactive, and safety-focused approach to work. 

What You'll Get 
30 paid vacation days per year 
4 additional Elekta days off 
Defined contribution pension scheme 
Private Medical Insurance 
Lunch benefit 
Contribution to wellness activities 
Collaborative office environment with opportunities to work alongside talented colleagues in a supportive and engaging workplace 

Application Process 
We look forward to receiving your application. Please submit your CV in English via the “Apply” button. We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage early applications.

jobs.description:
Behörig specialpedagog till åk 7-9 sökes!

Vill du jobba i en internationell miljö med tydlig pedagogisk vision? 

Internationella engelska skolan har gjort stor skillnad för våra elever i över 30 år. Vi är övertygade om att det är tack vare vårt tydliga etos med engagerade och närvarande ledare som våra skolor har en miljö där alla arbetar mot gemensamma mål. Vi har en stark kultur som bygger på beprövade rutiner. Hos oss får lärare fokus på undervisning och lärande. Eleverna står i centrum i allt vi gör, alla elever är våra elever.

På Internationella engelska skolan är vi ett team som drar åt samma håll. För att tycka om att jobba hos oss bör du dela vår övertygelse om vikten av tydliga värderingar, kollegialt lärande, gemensamma rutiner och förhållningssätt.   

IES är stolta över sina medarbetare och har tagit fram en metod för att skapa en lugn och trygg skolmiljö. Detta gör att våra lärare får mer tid till att dela sin kunskap, både med elever och kollegor. 

Vi söker nu en behörig specialpedagog för 7-9 med svensk lärarlegitimation.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med tillträde VT 2027. Provanställning tillämpas de första 6 månaderna. 

Tjänstebeskrivning

Vi söker dig som vill vara med och göra skillnad för eleverna i deras livslånga lärande. Vår verksamhet genomsyras av ett positivt synsätt och vi har en stark tilltro till elevernas förmåga. En stark värdegrund och positiv elevsyn är mycket viktig för oss. Tillsammans med dina kollegor arbetar du för att skapa en trygg, strukturerad, utvecklande och stimulerande lärmiljö för eleverna. Du arbetar tillsammans med ett elevhälsoteam bestående av rektor, bitr.rektor kurator, skolsköterska och speciallärare.  Vårt uppdrag är att tillsammans leda och stötta eleverna i deras sociala och kunskapsmässiga utveckling och där blir du en viktig del för både elever och lärare. 

Vem är du?

Du har svensk lärarexamen med specialpedagogskompetens samt svensk lärarlegitimation. Du har en klar pedagogisk insikt och förmåga att sätta läroplanens mål i ditt arbete. Du är trygg i din roll som specialpedagog. Du är flexibel, strukturerad och väl förberedd. Du är en närvarande och medforskande pedagog som utmanar och stimulerar eleverna till utveckling. En stark tro på samarbete som en framgångsfaktor för den pedagogiska utvecklingen, är en självklarhet för dig. Du har en rak och ödmjuk kommunikation med vårdnadshavare och skapar tillitsfulla relationer till elever, vårdnadshavare samt kollegor. 

Du bör vara positiv och samarbetsvillig och beredd på att ingå i ett internationellt team.  

I din roll är svenska det huvudsapkliga arbetsspråket, men kollegor emellan talar vi engelska i huvudsak men även svenska. Det gör att du behöver behärska båda språken flytande, både i tal och skrift. 

För mer information om vår skola, vänligen se https://engelska.se/our-schools/linkoping/

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan vilken du sänder till recruitment.linkoping@engelska.se Glöm inte att bifoga både CV och personligt brev. Märk ansökan med ”Spec.ped. åk 7-9 ”.

Intervjuer kommer att ske löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden gått ut, så skickas i din ansökan redan idag. Utdrag ur belastningsregistret och id krävs.

Are you passionate about digital business, e-commerce and technology? Do you enjoy understanding business needs, exploring technical solutions and turning ideas into digital capabilities?

We are looking for a Digital Business Developer to play an important role in the continued development of T-Store, our digital e-commerce platform. In this role, you will work at the intersection of business and technology, translating business requirements into functional and technically sound solutions.
You will work closely with business stakeholders, developers and solution architects, taking responsibility for the day-to-day product development of T-Store. This includes understanding business needs, managing requirements and priorities, shaping solutions and coordinating development activities from initial idea to implementation.
A key part of the role is understanding how different systems and applications interact. You will participate in technical discussions, contribute to solution design and work closely with architects and developers to ensure that new functionality is scalable, integrated and aligned with the wider application landscape.
You will also contribute to agile ways of working, testing and quality assurance, as well as identifying opportunities to improve our digital sales capabilities and customer experience.
Your main responsibilities will include:
Drive the day-to-day product development of T-Store, ensuring alignment with business needs and the overall product direction.
Work closely with business stakeholders to understand, challenge and translate business requirements into functional specifications and development requirements.
Own and maintain the product backlog, including requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and application-level priorities.
Participate in technical discussions and contribute to solution design, evaluating alternatives and identifying potential technical implications.
Coordinate development activities, requirements clarification and release planning.
Take part in agile team activities, including Scrum Master responsibilities, and contribute to continuous improvement of the team's ways of working.
Coordinate testing and quality assurance as Test Leader, ensuring that delivered functionality meets agreed requirements.
Identify opportunities for innovation and improvement within digital commerce, contributing to concept development and proof-of-concept initiatives.
We believe you have a combination of business understanding, technical curiosity and a structured approach to problem-solving. You are comfortable moving between business discussions and technical details, and you enjoy connecting the two to create practical solutions.
Experience in digital product development, e-commerce, technical business analysis, solution coordination or a similar role. 
Good understanding of web applications, system integrations and how different applications communicate. 
Ability to understand application architecture, technical dependencies and the implications of different solution approaches. 
Experience working with developers, solution architects or technical specialists. 
Ability to translate business requirements into clear functional requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria. 
Experience with agile development methods, preferably Scrum. 
A structured and analytical approach, combined with strong problem-solving skills. 
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with both business and technical stakeholders. 
Excellent written and spoken English. 
Experience with e-commerce platforms, cloud services or modern web technologies is considered an advantage.

Our Offer 
At Toyota Material Handling, you will become part of an international organisation with a strong focus on innovation, digitalization and continuous improvement.
You will have the opportunity to influence the development of an important digital sales platform and contribute to how our customers interact with Toyota through digital channels.
The role offers a unique combination of business development, product management and technical solution work. You will collaborate with experienced developers, solution architects and business stakeholders, giving you the opportunity to broaden your technical understanding while having a tangible impact on our digital products.
You will be part of Digital Business & Connectivity in Mjölby, working in a collaborative environment where business understanding, technology and innovation come together. 
Your Application 
Send your application, CV, and Cover letter in Swedish or English, no later than December the 6th 2026. We screen continuously, so do not miss out and send in your application today!

jobs.occupation: Business Area Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
Information security is critical to achieving our strategic objectives and building resilient operations. As Business Area Chief Information Security Officer (BA CISO), you lead information security and resilience across Business Area Rock Processing, ensuring that security is embedded in business operations, IT and OT environments, and digital products.  
About the job 
You set the direction for information security across the Business Area and ensure that risks are effectively managed while legal, regulatory, customer and Sandvik requirements are met. Acting as principal advisor to Business Area Management, you connect strategic priorities with effective security governance and execution. You report to the Business Area VP IT & CIO.  
Job responsibilities 
Lead the Business Area security team and drive a strong security culture and awareness. 
Manage information security risks across IT, OT and digital products. 
Ensure and monitor compliance with Sandvik requirements, applicable laws and regulations, customer requirements and Business Area maturity targets. 
Advise Business Area Management on information security and cyber risk, and report on compliance to Business Area Management and the Sandvik CISO. 
Represent the Business Area in the Sandvik Information & IT Security Council and other relevant governance bodies.  

Location & flexibility 
This position is flexible within Europe, and regular international travel is expected. 
Your profile 
You’re an experienced information security leader with a strong track record from a large, international organization. Your background combines strategic security leadership with risk and compliance management across IT and OT environments, preferably including digital products.  
Your background includes: 
Extensive experience in information security leadership, risk management and compliance. 
Experience leading a team and advising and communicating with executive management. 
A university degree in information security, computer science, engineering or equivalent. 
Professional fluency in English. 
Strong capabilities in organizational leadership, change management, strategic planning and executive stakeholder management.  

Knowledge of information security laws, regulations and standards such as EU NIS2, the EU Cyber Resilience Act, the EU AI Act, ISO 27001 and IEC 62443 are an advantage, as is a recognized information security certification. 
Being strategic and confident in an executive setting, you combine strong communication skills with the ability to lead change and bring security perspectives into business decisions. You’re comfortable working across organizational boundaries and engaging stakeholders at multiple levels.  
The team 
You lead the Business Area security team and collaborate closely with Business Area Management, the Business Area CIO, the Sandvik CISO and owners of IT, OT and digital product environments. You also represent the Business Area in Sandvik-wide information security governance forums. 
Our culture 
At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences.
